meta.title: AI Feedback & Evaluation: Correct Your AI Agent | Cekat.AI
meta.description: Flag off-target AI replies from live chats, test changes in the AI Playground before they ship, and manage evaluation history. Your AI improves because you correct it.

hero.title: Correct It Once, and the AI Stays Corrected
hero.subtitle: Flag an off-target reply straight from the conversation, test the fix in the AI Playground before customers see it, and keep every evaluation on record for review.

definition: AI Feedback & Evaluation in Cekat.AI is the quality loop for the AI agent: flagging off-target responses from live conversations, testing answers in the AI Playground before they are used, and managing the evaluation history from one page.

benefits.title: Flag a Bad Answer Without Leaving the Chat
benefits.body: From a live conversation, the team gives an off-target response a thumbs down. No internal ticket, no complaint spreadsheet: the correction happens where the problem was spotted.
benefits.imageAlt: Flagging an AI response from a live conversation

benefits.title: Test in the Playground, Not on Customers
benefits.body: The AI Playground lets you throw questions at the AI and inspect its answers before they reach a real conversation. Knowledge and settings changes get tried first; customers are not the test bench.
benefits.imageAlt: Testing AI answers in the AI Playground

benefits.title: Every Evaluation Kept, Editable, Removable
benefits.body: The Evaluation page holds the whole feedback history: what was corrected, what is stale and can go. Your AI's improvement is documented rather than scattered across team chats.

benefits.title: An AI That Improves From Real Cases
benefits.body: Corrections come from genuine conversations with your customers, not invented scenarios. An answer fixed today prevents the same mistake across the next thousand chats.
benefits.imageAlt: AI improvement grounded in real conversations

benefits.title: Your CS Team Becomes the Coach, Not the Patch
benefits.body: Instead of taking over the same chat again and again, the team corrects the source once. Time that went into patching AI answers moves to the cases that truly need a human.
benefits.imageAlt: A team coaching the AI instead of patching answers

pillars.title: Corrected at the Scene
pillars.body: Feedback is given from the conversation itself, while the context is still whole.

pillars.title: Safe Before It Ships
pillars.body: The Playground separates experiments from real conversations, so a fix cannot create a new problem.

pillars.title: Documented, Not Implied
pillars.body: Evaluation history can be opened, edited, and removed, so you know exactly what has been corrected.

faq.q: What is AI Feedback & Evaluation in Cekat.AI?
faq.a: The AI quality loop: flag off-target responses from live chats with a thumbs down, test answers in the AI Playground, and manage the whole evaluation history from one page.

faq.q: How do I give feedback on an AI reply?
faq.a: From a live conversation, hover over the Resolve section and click the thumbs-down icon on the response you want corrected. The evaluation is recorded without leaving the chat.
A place to test the AI before its answers reach customers. Ask it questions, inspect the responses, and judge the results in an environment separate from real conversations.

faq.q: Can old evaluations be edited or removed?
faq.a: Yes. The Evaluation page lists the feedback history for review, editing when a correction needs refining, and removal once it is no longer relevant.

faq.q: Who should be giving the feedback?
faq.a: Whoever knows the right answer best, usually CS or a supervisor. Because it is one click from the chat, correcting becomes a daily habit rather than a special project.

faq.q: How is this different from retraining the knowledge base?
faq.a: The knowledge base is the source of what the AI knows; evaluation corrects how it answers. They complement each other: feedback often reveals which part of the knowledge needs sharpening.

faq.q: Does feedback change the AI's answers immediately?
faq.a: Evaluations are recorded and become managed corrections. You test the change in the Playground first, so no correction ships unreviewed.

faq.q: Does this feature need technical skill?
faq.a: No. Feedback is one click, the Playground is an ordinary conversation, and the evaluation page is a searchable list. All of it is built for non-technical teams.

cta.heading: Make Every AI Mistake Its Last
cta.body: Flag it, test it, ship it. Your AI improves on your own team's corrections. Try it free.
